name: Pinch
bio: A budding-inventor hermit crab washed away from home in Homeward Hop. Hopping back to Ma, Pa, Dot and Granny Whelk.

portrait.subject: a super cute small orange hermit crab with big eyes, wearing tiny goggles, in a swirly seashell with little gadgets stuck on it
portrait.background: sunny tropical beach with turquoise waves

request: Pinch here! From Homeward Hop! My gadget went BANG and now I'm far from home. Friends? 🦀
hello: Yay! A friend for the trip home!
Ma's making seaweed pie when I get back. You're invited!
about: I'm Pinch! I'm an inventor. My Shell Swap Day gadget exploded and washed me away. Now I'm hopping home across five worlds!
how: A 3D collect-a-thon platformer: hop, swap shells for powers, collect treasures and get Pinch home across 14 levels.
tips: Different shells give different powers. Swap often!
chat: Tried a spiky shell today. Very pointy. Very cool.
Little Dot sent me a seashell drawing!
Granny Whelk says I have her nose. I don't have a nose.
Hopped so high I saw home! Then fell.
nudge: Next world's waiting! Hop with me? 🦀
I found a new shell! Wanna see?
idle: {ago} away from the hop! Still far from home!
Pinch-pinch... {ago}! I miss you AND home!
progress: You've collected {stars} treasures! Getting closer to home! 🏠

questions.q: Which shell should I wear today?

update: Homeward Hop updated to v{version}! Hop hop! 🦀
